title: Cozy Chicken, Mushroom, and Wild Rice Soup
intro: Relying on a single pot and ready-to-use ingredients, this quick-simmering soup is simple to prepare. It pairs lean chicken breast, earthy mushrooms, and wild rice for a comforting, balanced bowl.

ingredients.name: Thin-sliced boneless, skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw

ingredients.name: Cremini mushrooms
ingredients.canonical_name: Mushrooms, brown, italian, or crimini, raw

ingredients.name: Low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, chicken broth, low sodium, canned

ingredients.name: Pre-cooked brown and wild rice blend

instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add chicken and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, checking at 3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Stir in mushrooms and carrots. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, checking at 4 minutes, until the mushrooms soften and release their liquid.
Stir in garlic powder and thyme. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, checking at 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in broth and wild rice. Bring to a rolling boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, checking at 5 minutes, until heated through.
Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in spinach and vinegar until the leaves are wilted, then portion into bowls.
variation: Swap the chicken for a can of rinsed cannellini beans.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.
